ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Handling of Renee Good's Case
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's actions in the Renee Good case, including the decision to stop the FBI investigation and the potential motivations behind it.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding Renee Good's death?
Why did the Trump administration stop the FBI investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal and shed light on the Trump administration's actions. It requires careful investigation and analysis of the available evidence.
